correctness.rationale: At exponential stationary age A, independent conditional Gaussian coordinates have variances v_i(A)=(D_i/gamma_i)(1-exp(-2 gamma_i A)). Laplace integration gives M_i>0 and Cov(v_i,v_j)/(M_iM_j)=1/(1+2 gamma_i/r+2 gamma_j/r). Wick cumulants give exactly the stated normalization even at i=j. Algebra yields the harmonic mean and if-and-only-if constructive inverse for arbitrary positive diagonal targets with positive rates and noises. The Cauchy determinant gives exact total positivity for distinct b, and rank equals distinct b groups. The standalone exact-rational script checks several finite instances without being relied on for the general proof.
